instruction: Put the yellow book in the purple box.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
obj = obs["objects"]["yellow_book"]
zone = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]

# Check if purple_box is occupied
occupied = False
zone_half_size = zone["half_size"]
zone_center = zone["center"]
for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
    if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone_center[0]) < zone_half_size[0] + 0.01 and
        abs(o["center"][1] - zone_center[1]) < zone_half_size[1] + 0.01 and
        o["top_z"] < zone_center[2] + 0.01):
        if o_name != "yellow_book":
            occupied = True
            break

if occupied:
    # Clear purple_box by moving the object inside to cyan_tray
    for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
        if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone_center[0]) < zone_half_size[0] + 0.01 and
            abs(o["center"][1] - zone_center[1]) < zone_half_size[1] + 0.01 and
            o["top_z"] < zone_center[2] + 0.01 and o_name != "yellow_book"):
            pick(o_name, 0.02, o["long_axis_yaw"])
            place("cyan_tray")
            break

# Pick up yellow_book with grasp_height 0.0125 and yaw aligned to long_axis_yaw
pick("yellow_book", 0.0125, obj["long_axis_yaw"])

# Place on purple_box centered
place("purple_box")

task_spec.refined_instruction: The robot must first confirm that the yellow_book is not already in the purple_box. If the purple_box is occupied, the robot must clear it by moving any object currently inside to another zone (e.g., cyan_tray), ensuring the purple_box is empty. Then, the robot must pick up the yellow_book from its current location (which is not on any zone, so it must be detected in the environment) and place it inside the purple_box. Success is confirmed when the yellow_book is fully inside the purple_box and no other object is in the purple_box.
